_comment: Vendoring contract for install-modules.sh --tool / bootstrap. The script copies this tool to <host>/.claude/tools/search-docs/, substitutes __DIR__ with that host-relative path, and emits the `server` block as a ready-to-merge entry for the host's root .mcp.json. The server KEY (search_docs) and entrypoint (search-docs-server) are canonical here so the script stays tool-agnostic; do not rename the key — the tool surfaces in the warehouse as mcp__search_docs__search and the H1/H2 analyses key on it.
